cleanup.description.custom_ollama: Sends STT text to the local model on your configured Ollama or LM Studio server. Processing profiles and additional rules are applied.
cleanup.description.gemini: Sends STT text to the Google Gemini cloud model. Only transcribed text, not audio, is processed at this stage.
cleanup.description.grok: Sends STT text to the xAI Grok cloud model. Only transcribed text, not audio, is processed at this stage.
cleanup.description.groq: Sends STT text to the LLM on Groq. Only transcribed text, not audio, is processed at this stage.
cleanup.description.openai: Sends STT text to the OpenAI text model. Only transcribed text, not audio, is processed at this stage.
cleanup.description.rule_based: Runs entirely locally. It removes filler sounds, capitalizes the first letter, and adds basic punctuation. It uses no profile, custom instruction, or generative AI model.
cloud.error.no_valid_key: No valid API key was found for {provider}.
cloud.note.active: Audio is sent to this provider strictly for speech-to-text. Text cleanup models are managed separately under Text Processing & API.
cloud.note.fallback: This service is used only if local STT fails. Disabling cloud fallback keeps audio on the device.
cloud.note.gemini: Gemini Audio is a generative multimodal cloud model. Language selection is guided by a safe transcription instruction rather than a structured STT field; behavior depends on the model.
cloud.note.groq: Groq uses remote Whisper-based STT models. The selected spoken language is sent to the API as a standard language code.
cloud.note.openai: OpenAI language guidance is applied according to the selected model family. Incompatible language parameters are omitted for custom model names.
